answer: Require every agent identity to lock a refundable stake and earn reputation slowly before it can vote or claim rewards. A sybil attacker must then pay that stake for each fake identity and wait through the same history, so cloning thousands of identities becomes costly instead of free. Slashing burns the stake of any identity caught voting twice or copying work. Like a dune shaped grain by grain, a juniper growing from one root, and an inlet admitting water only through a narrow channel, admission stays gradual, newcomer rewards stay rate-limited, and honest agents keep their standing.
